text_simplified: Malik ibn Dinar saw a man who prayed poorly and said: 'How I pity his children!' When asked about that, he said: 'He is their elder and from him they learn.' The Sheikh comments that a parent's crime against his child is great when he serves as a role model in abandoning obligations or committing forbidden acts, because children generally grow up influenced by their father's behavior.
